category_description: Buying, financing and selling a home in the United States.
subcategory_description: The tax rules that apply when you sell your home.
label: Most gain you can exclude on the sale of your main home
context: For a person who meets the ownership and use tests. The exclusion applies to the capital gain from selling your main home.

label: Most gain a married couple filing jointly can exclude
context: Applies when you file a joint return with your spouse and the ownership and use tests are met.

label: Ownership and use needed in the last 5 years
context: You must have owned the home for at least this long, and used it as your residence for at least this long, in the 5 years ending on the date of sale. The two periods can fall at different times.

subject_intro: How much gain on selling your main home can be left out of income, the ownership and use tests, and when you still have to report the sale.
subject_meta_title: Home Sale Tax Exclusion: Up to {fact:us_home_excl_single}
subject_meta_description: You may exclude up to {fact:us_home_excl_single} of gain from selling your main home, or {fact:us_home_excl_joint} on a joint return. See the ownership and use tests and reporting rules.
